items.title: Meta ordered to pay $25B for privacy deception
items.feedTitle: Judge orders Meta to pay New Mexico $25B in Cambridge Analytica case
items.summary: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion after a jury found the company liable for misleading users about its privacy and content policies in a case linked to the Cambridge Analytica scandal. The penalty is the largest ever imposed on Facebook's parent company, exceeding an $18 billion settlement with California. New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez called it "one of the single largest" judgments against a tech firm.

items.title: Toledo chemical leak forces mass evacuations
items.feedTitle: ‘Error’ caused Toledo chemical leak, EPA says, triggering evacuations and fear of explosion
items.summary: An error caused a chemical tank explosion in Toledo, Ohio, releasing glycidyl methacrylate into the air and triggering evacuations and fears of additional explosions. The EPA said people exposed to the chemical may experience burning eyes, nose, mouth, and skin, with overexposure causing headaches, dizziness, nausea, and vomiting. Shelter-in-place orders remained in effect for several hours following the incident.

items.title: UN warns world will exceed 1.5-degree climate target
items.feedTitle: UN climate report says world will fail 1.5-degree Paris goal but argues for keeping overshoot brief
items.summary: A new United Nations climate report said global temperatures are set to exceed 1.5 degrees Celsius above preindustrial levels, though urgent emissions cuts can help reduce the overshoot. The report argues against abandoning climate goals even if the threshold is breached, emphasizing that the duration of overshoot matters significantly.

items.title: Springfield faces Haitian refugee exodus
items.feedTitle: ‘There are no people’: Springfield, Ohio, faces loss of Haitian residents
items.summary: Springfield, Ohio, is experiencing a significant loss of Haitian residents as Trump's deportation drive reshapes the community that has undergone demographic transformation. Local leaders report residents are departing amid enforcement actions, reversing years of population growth driven by Haitian migration.

items.title: NSA warns of critical PHP programming language flaws
items.feedTitle: NSA warns organizations to patch security flaws identified by AI
items.summary: The National Security Agency warned organizations to immediately patch critical security vulnerabilities discovered by artificial intelligence in PHP, a key programming language. The discovery highlights how AI can identify previously unknown security risks, though it also prompted urgent system patching worldwide.

The incident appears connected to a dispute over a sexual encounter, and authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the deadly fire.

stlouis.summary: A husband and wife have been charged in the shooting death of a Missouri high school student who was traveling to a St. Louis Halloween party. The fatal incident is being prosecuted in connection with an I-170 shooting case that has drawn significant law enforcement attention.

cards.title: Start with the smallest unit
cards.insight: Major change rarely sticks when attempted all at once. Breaking habits or building new routines is easier when you reduce the action to its smallest, least-resistance form—a single push-up instead of a full workout, one sentence instead of an essay.
cards.takeaway: This week, identify one habit you want to change and make the first iteration so trivial it feels effortless to do.

cards.title: Environment designs behavior more than willpower
cards.insight: Changing your surroundings often outperforms motivation-based approaches. Leaving gym clothes on the bed, placing a water bottle where you sit, or removing junk food visibility all reduce friction without requiring daily resolve.
cards.takeaway: Rearrange one physical space today to make your desired behavior easier and the unwanted one harder.

cards.title: Anchor new habits to existing routines
cards.insight: New behaviors stick better when attached to something you already do daily—brushing teeth, morning coffee, lunch break. This leverages existing neural pathways rather than forcing a standalone routine into a packed schedule.
cards.takeaway: Choose one existing daily habit and attach a new 60-second behavior to it for the next week.

cards.title: Track visible progress, not just outcomes
cards.insight: Seeing a streak of compliance or a log of effort creates dopamine signals that reinforce repetition. The act of recording—a checkmark, a note—becomes a reward itself, independent of whether the outcome is yet visible.
cards.takeaway: Pick a habit and find one simple way to mark each day you do it; review after one week.
